script_text: Sagittarius, the cosmos is forcing a major career and love transformation starting right here this Monday. Your ruling planet Jupiter anchors the 10th House of status, so Mercury trine Jupiter boosts professional momentum Monday and Tuesday for this fire sign. Personal money matters move favorably very soon. But by Wednesday, Venus sextiles fiery Mars, suddenly igniting passionate love connection, romance, and deep, lasting intimacy in your 7th House of committed partnership. Thursday brings Saturn in the 6th House scrutinizing your daily work habits and intense stress levels, yet the weekend finally relaxes your wild, fiery energy completely and restores your inner balance fully. Wednesday is your great power day because Venus sextiles Mars. Friday is your absolute worst day because Saturn opposes Venus. Ask for your promotion Monday morning, but stay quiet to avoid unnecessary conflicts with your boss this week. Please follow for daily updates always.
